blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong policies for vision-and-language navigation (VLN). However, most of them encode a sample of past frames again at every decision and are trained on isolated decisions, so computation is redundant and the usable history is short. They also learn from their own mistakes through outcome rewards that give one scalar to a whole episode. We ask whether a navigator can encode each frame only once, at a constant cost per step, and still remember what matters and learn efficiently from its mistakes. We present GlanceNav, a streaming navigator built on a hybrid MLLM. Its Gated DeltaNet layers carry a recurrent state through the whole episode, while its attention layers keep a short window of recent observations and a small bank of keyframes, selected by how much each frame changes the recurrent state. This constant-size memory keeps the cost per step fixed and allows training on whole episodes with the same memory as at inference. Because the entire memory can also be copied in constant time, we further propose Counterfactual Rewind (CoRe), a reinforcement learning stage that rewinds a drifting rollout to its closest approach to the goal, lets an expert correct a few actions, and credits decisions by the resulting change in outcome. Trained only on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE training splits, with 1,000 instructions for reinforcement learning, a 4B GlanceNav reaches success rates of 71.9% and 73.6% on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen. On R2R-CE, it outperforms the strongest previous single-RGB method trained without external data by 9.1 points, while running at 104 ms per step.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)已成为视觉和语言导航的有力政策。 然而,它们大多在每次决定时再次编码一个过去帧的样本,并接受过孤立决定的培训,因此计算是多余的,可用的历史很短. 他们还通过结果奖励从自己的错误中吸取教训,结果奖励给整个剧集一个分级. 我们问一个导航员是否可以只编码每个帧一次,每步费用不变,并且仍然记得什么很重要,并从错误中有效地吸取教训. 我们介绍GlanceNav, 一个流线导航器 建立在混合MLLM上。 它的Gated DeltaNet层通过整个剧集承载一个经常状态,而它的注意力层则保留着一个短窗口来记录最近的观测结果和一个小的密钥框库,根据每个帧对经常状态的改变多少来选择. 这种恒定大小的内存保持每步成本固定,并允许以与推论相同的内存对整个剧集进行培训. 由于整个内存也可以在恒定时间内复制,我们进一步提出反事实倒转(CoRe),这个强化的学习阶段将漂移的展开倒向最接近目标的方法,让一位专家纠正一些行动,并通过由此产生的结果变化来信用决定. 仅在R2R-CE和RxR-CE的训练中进行训练,有1000个强化学习指令,4B GlanceNav在R2R-CE和RxR-CE val-unseen上成功率分别达到71.9%和73.6%. 在R2R-CE上,它比以往在没有外部数据的情况下训练的最强的单RGB方法的成绩高出9.1分,同时每步运行104ms.

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE) [ 3 , 18 , 20 ] asks an agent to follow a natural-language instruction through an unseen building, using only its egocentric observations.
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) now power most strong VLN-CE agents [ 50 , 49 , 5 , 40 , 48 ] .
Many of them treat navigation as video question answering ( Fig. 1 a): at every step, they sample a fixed number of past frames, typically eight, and encode them again together with the current view.
blocks.zh:
连续环境中的视觉和语言导航(VLN-CE)[3,18,20]要求代理人通过一个看不见的建筑遵循自然语言的指令,只使用其自我中心观测.
多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)现在为最强大的VLN-CE代理[50,49,5,40,48]提供动力.
其中许多将导航视为视频问题回答(图1a):在每一个步骤上,它们都对一个固定的过去帧数进行抽样,一般是8个,然后与当前视图一起重新编码.

blocks.en:
This design has two problems.
The first is the memory: each frame is processed once for every later decision that samples it, the policy cannot see what falls outside the sample, and every decision is trained as a separate sample.
Streaming navigators avoid re-encoding by caching the key-value (KV) states of past observations [ 40 , 56 ] .
A full cache, however, grows linearly with the episode, so these methods bound it with sliding windows and pruned or compressed memories.
Bounding the cache fixes the cost but not the memory: eviction is final, and whatever leaves the cache is invisible to every later decision.
The second problem is how the agent learns from its own mistakes.
Beyond DAgger [ 27 ] , recent navigators are fine-tuned with outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) such as GRPO [ 30 , 55 ] , which gives one scalar to all of the roughly one hundred decisions of a rollout and learns mostly from instructions on which some rollouts succeed and others fail, which become rarer as the policy improves.
We therefore ask: can a navigator encode each frame only once, at a constant cost per step, and still remember what matters and learn efficiently from its own mistakes?
blocks.zh:
这种设计有两个问题.
第一种是内存:每个框架都经过一次处理,用于以后每次决定其样本,保单无法看到样本之外的东西,每个决定都作为单独的样本来训练.
流线导航器避免通过卡住过去观测的键值状态(KV)来重新编码[40,56].
然而,一个完整的缓存随着剧集的线性增长,因此这些方法将它与滑动的窗口和被挤压或压缩的记忆捆绑在一起.
突破缓存可以固定成本,但不能固定记忆:驱逐是最终的,不管留下什么缓存,对于以后的每一个决定都是看不见的.
第二个问题是代理人如何从自己的错误中吸取教训.
除了Dagger[27]之外,最近的航海家们通过基于成果的强化学习(RL)进行微调,如GRPO[30,55],这给大约一百项推出决定中的所有决定都提供了一个分量,并且主要从一些推出成功而另一些则失败的指示中学习,随着政策改善,这些指示变得更加罕见.
因此,我们问:一个航海家能否只用每一步的固定成本为每个框架编码一次,并且仍然记得什么很重要,并从自己的错误中有效地吸取教训?

blocks.en:
Hybrid MLLMs [ 45 , 11 , 26 ] remove the need to choose between cost and memory.
Most of their layers are Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, which fold every token into a fixed-size recurrent state, and only a few are softmax attention.
The whole episode is therefore always summarized in the state. The summary is lossy, so the few attention layers still need exact tokens, but only as a complement.
The memory question thus changes from which part of the history to keep to which few frames should also be kept exactly.
blocks.zh:
混合 MLLMs [45, 11, 26] 取消了在成本和内存之间做出选择的必要性.
它们的地层大多是Gated DeltaNet(GDN)地层,这些地层将每个令牌折叠成固定大小的经常性状态,只有少数是软马克思注意力.
因此,整个剧集总是在州内进行总结. 总结是失落的,所以少数关注层仍然需要精确的代号,但只是作为补充.
因此,记忆问题改变了历史中应该保留哪些部分,确切地说,应该保留多少帧。

blocks.en:
GlanceNav ( Fig. 1 b) answers this question with the state itself.
Its attention layers see a window of the most recent observations and a small bank of older keyframes , selected by a state-change score : the relative change that a frame causes in the recurrent state of the GDN layer below. A frame that the state already predicts changes it little, whereas a frame with new content, such as a new room, changes it more and is kept.
The score has no parameters.
Two properties follow.
The memory has a constant size: each frame is encoded once, and a step costs the same throughout an episode.
It is also causal: keyframes are selected from the past only, so the memory of every step can be built inside one forward pass over an episode, and GlanceNav is trained on whole episodes with its test-time memory instead of on isolated decisions.
blocks.zh:
GlanceNav(图1b)用国家本身来回答这个问题.
它的注意力层看到一个最新观测的窗口和一个小的旧键框库,这些键框是由一个状态变化分数所选择的:一个帧导致下面GDN层的反复状态的相对变化. 一种状态已经预测到它变化不大的帧,而具有新内容的帧,如新房间,则会改变更多,被保留.
得分没有参数.
二属性随顺.
内存有恒定大小:每帧编码一次,一个步骤在整个剧集中成本相同.
它也是因果:键框只从过去中选择,所以每个步骤的记忆可以建在一个向前传过一集的内部,而GlanceNav则用其测试时间的记忆来训练整集,而不是孤立的决定.

blocks.en:
The constant size also addresses the second problem: a snapshot of the agent’s entire memory takes 136 MiB and 1.4 ms to copy, at any step, so a rollout can be rewound to any earlier decision.
Our Counterfactual Rewind (CoRe) detects when a rollout starts to move away from the goal, restores the simulator and the agent’s memory at the rollout’s closest approach to the goal, lets a shortest-path expert redo a few actions, and lets the policy finish.
The difference in outcome between this branch and the original rollout then credits the policy’s continuation, and the expert’s actions only when the branch did better.
A drifting rollout thus yields a contrast between two outcomes from the same state, instead of one scalar for the whole episode.
blocks.zh:
恒定尺寸也解决了第二个问题:对代理机整个内存的快照需要136 MiB和1.4 ms 来复制,在任何步骤上,这样推开就可以重回任何早期的决定.
我们的反事实倒转(CoRe)探测到一个推出开始偏离目标时,在推出最接近目标时恢复模拟器和代理器的记忆,让最短路径的专家重新做几个动作,让政策完成.
然后,这一分支机构与最初推出的分支机构之间的结果差异,才将政策的持续和专家的行动计入该分支机构的绩效。
因此,漂移的推出在同一种状态的两个结果之间产生了对比,而不是整个剧集的一幅平面图。

blocks.en:
We train GlanceNav in three stages, using only the R2R-CE and RxR-CE training splits: episode-level supervised fine-tuning (SFT), DAgger, and CoRe on 1,000 instructions.
With a 4B backbone, GlanceNav reaches 71.9% success rate (SR) on R2R-CE val-unseen and 73.6% on RxR-CE ( Fig. 1 c, Tab. 1 ).
On R2R-CE, this is 9.1 points above the best previous single-RGB method trained without external data, and among all single-RGB methods that we compare with, only an 8B model trained with additional data scores higher.
GlanceNav runs at 104 ms per step, less than half the step time of a step-wise navigator with a backbone of the same size ( Tab. 3 ).

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Vision-language models for navigation. Early VLN-CE agents rely on panoramas, depth and waypoint predictors [ 18 , 19 , 13 , 37 ] .
Video MLLMs made navigation from a single RGB camera competitive [ 50 , 49 , 5 ] .
Later work scales the training data [ 51 , 52 ] , or adds self-correction data [ 47 ] , dual-system planners [ 39 , 43 ] , geometry encoders [ 48 , 53 , 25 ] , auxiliary objectives [ 57 , 7 , 34 ] , agentic decomposition [ 42 ] or stereo input [ 35 ] .
Most of these methods build each decision from a resampled set of frames, and their best results use external data such as ScaleVLN [ 36 ] , VQA or web video.
GlanceNav keeps one persistent stream and uses no external data.
blocks.zh:
导航的远景语言模型. 早期的VLN-CE剂依赖于全景,深度和中途点预测器[18,19,13,37].
Video MLLMs让单台RGB相机的导航具有竞争力[50,49,5].
后期工作尺度为培训数据[51,52],或增加自校数据[47],双系统规划者[39,43],几何编码器[48,53,25],辅助目标[57,7,34],代理分解[42]或立体输入[35].
这些方法大多通过一个重印的一组帧来构建每个决定,其最佳结果使用外部数据如ScaleVLN [36],VQA或网络视频.
GlanceNav保持一个持久性流,没有使用外部数据.

blocks.en:
Streaming and selective memory. StreamVLN [ 40 ] keeps a sliding window of dialogue turns and a pruned memory of older ones. JanusVLN [ 48 ] keeps the KV caches of the initial and the most recent frames from a semantic and a geometry encoder [ 31 ] .
Efficient-VLN [ 56 ] reuses the KV cache as well and packs several decisions of a trajectory into one training sequence.
In LLMs and video models, KV-eviction methods keep tokens by recency, attention mass or query relevance [ 41 , 54 , 23 ] .
Linear-attention and state-space layers replace the cache with a fixed-size state [ 29 , 10 , 8 , 44 , 45 ] , and hybrid models interleave them with a few attention layers [ 17 , 26 ] .
Two recent works read the delta rule to decide which exact tokens to keep: HOLA [ 6 ] keeps tokens with a large committed write, and the concurrent DeltaS [ 21 ] evicts video chunks by their state drift without training.
Our state-change score belongs to this family. Unlike these works, which target language and video understanding, we train a navigation policy end to end with the resulting memory and evaluate it in closed-loop control.
blocks.zh:
流和选择性记忆. StreamVLN [40] 保持一个滑动的窗口对话转动,并保持一个对旧的回憶. JanusVLN [48] 从语义和几何编码器保留初始和最近帧的KV缓存 [31].
高效的VLN[56]再利用KV缓存,并将数个轨道决定装入一个训练序列。
在LLMs和视频模型中,KV-校验方法通过Recentity,注意质量或查询相关性来保留符号[41,54,23].
线性注意层和状态空间层用固定大小的状态[29,10,8,44,45]取代缓存,混合模型将它们与几个注意层[17,26]互留.
最近两部作品阅读了三角洲规则,以决定要保留哪些具体标志:HOLA [6] 保留一个大型承诺书的标志,同时代号DeltaS [21] 在未经训练的情况下通过状态漂移驱逐视频块.
我们的州变分属于这个家族 与这些以语言和视频理解为目标的作品不同的是,我们训练一个导航政策结束于由此产生的内存,并在闭路控制下对其进行评价.

blocks.en:
Learning from policy errors. DAgger [ 27 ] labels the states visited by the learner and is widely used by MLLM navigators [ 40 , 48 , 56 ] .
ActiveVLN [ 55 ] trains an MLLM navigator with multi-turn GRPO [ 30 ] , which we adopt as our RL baseline.
Recent methods make its sparse outcome reward more informative: SACA [ 22 ] resamples from a divergence point found by an auditor, SeekVLN [ 38 ] contrasts counterfactual branches at evidence-seeking steps, and BudVLN [ 12 ] rectifies failures from the farthest progress along the reference path.
Branching from intermediate states is also used in LLM reasoning [ 15 ] , exploration [ 9 ] and test-time backtracking for VLN [ 16 ] .
CoRe branches at the closest approach to the goal, restores the full streaming memory there in 𝒪 ⁡ ( 1 ) \mathcal{O}(1) , and imitates the expert only when its branch outperforms the original rollout, a Q-filter [ 24 ] estimated by a rollout instead of a learned critic.
blocks.zh:
学习政策错误。 Dagger [27] 给学习者访问的州贴上标签,并被MLLM导航员广泛使用[40,48,56].
ActiveVLN [55] 列车MLLM导航器,采用多回合GRPO [30],作为RL基线.
最近的方法使得其微薄的结果回报更加丰富:SACA[22]从审计师发现的分歧点重现,SEEVLN[38]在寻找证据的步骤上对比了反事实分支,BudVLN[12]在参考路径上纠正了最远的进展的失败.
在LLM推理[15],勘探[9]和试验时间回溯跟踪中,中间状态的分支也被用于VLN[16].
Core分支在最接近目标的方法上,恢复O QQ (1)\mathcal{O}(1)中完整的流体内存,并且只有在其分支表现优于原版推出时,才模仿专家,一个Q过滤器[24]通过推出而不是一个有学问的批评者来估计.

blocks.en:
Benchmarks and metrics. We evaluate on the val-unseen splits of R2R-CE [ 18 ] (1,839 episodes) and RxR-CE [ 20 ] (3,669 English episodes) in Habitat [ 28 ] with Matterport3D scenes [ 4 ] .
The agent observes 480 × 640 480{\times}640 RGB images, moves forward 0.25 m or turns 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} per action, and succeeds if it stops within 3 m of the goal.
Following standard practice, we report navigation error (NE), oracle success (OS), success rate (SR) and success weighted by path length (SPL) [ 2 ] , and on RxR-CE also normalized dynamic time warping (nDTW) [ 14 ] .

基准和衡量标准。 我们评价了R2R-CE [18] (1,839集)和RxR-CE [20] (3,669集英语)在人居[28]与Materport3的val-unseen分裂. D场景 [4].

按照标准惯例,我们报告导航误差(NE),甲骨文成功(OS),成功率(SR)和成功率按路径长度加权(SPL)[2],在RxR-CE上,还实现了动态时间抖动正常化(nDTW)[14].

The memory keeps W = 4 W{=}4 recent steps and F = 4 F{=}4 keyframes per attention layer, so attention reads at most 4,784 KV rows per layer, and the recurrent state occupies 48 MiB.

blocks.en:
Training. All three stages use only the R2R-CE and English RxR-CE training splits (30,815 episodes with 3.13M actions).
Stage 1 trains for one epoch, which takes 13.5 h on four H100 GPUs.
Stage 2 collects DAgger episodes with the Stage-1 policy on the same instructions and trains for one more epoch with the same recipe.
Stage 3 runs CoRe on 1,000 training instructions, 500 from R2R-CE and 500 from RxR-CE.
Each update uses G = 4 G{=}4 rollouts per instruction, and one pass over the 1,000 instructions takes 125 updates, or 12.5 h on two RTX PRO 6000 GPUs.
CoRe uses a trigger margin η = 1 \eta{=}1 m and at most H = 16 H{=}16 expert actions.
Full hyperparameters and data-collection settings will be released with the code.

blocks.en: 4.2  Comparison with the State of the Art
blocks.zh: 4.2 与艺术状况的比较

blocks.en:
Navigation performance. GlanceNav reaches 71.9 SR and 63.7 SPL on R2R-CE val-unseen ( Tab. 1 ).
Among single-RGB methods that use only the R2R-CE and RxR-CE training splits, the best previous SR that we are aware of is 62.8 (ReflectVLN [ 32 ] , which runs two 3B models and trains on recovery data), and the best SR from demonstrations alone is 56.3 (StageVLN [ 7 ] ).
GlanceNav improves on them by 9.1 and 15.6 points with a 4B backbone.
Among all single-RGB methods of Tab. 1 , only Efficient-VLN [ 56 ] , an 8B model trained with ScaleVLN data, has a higher SR (73.2), and GlanceNav has the highest OS (78.6).
On RxR-CE, GlanceNav reaches 73.6 SR, 7.6 points above ReflectVLN, and again only Efficient-VLN is higher (75.6).

GlanceNav用4B骨干提升了9.1分和15.6分.

在RxR-CE上,GlanceNav达到73.6SR,比ReflectVLN高7.6分,同样只有高效VLN更高(75.6).

Inference cost. Table 3 follows the protocol of StageVLN [ 7 ] .
On an RTX PRO 6000, GlanceNav takes 103.9 ms and 8.68 GiB per step, about half the time and memory of StreamVLN and less than half the time of StageVLN, which re-encodes eight frames with a backbone of the same size.
Because the memory has a constant size, the step time stays flat along an episode. With a full KV cache instead, the same backbone slows from 93.6 to 152.8 ms per step over 500 steps, while an eight-step window stays at 84 ms ( Tab. 4 ).
For the same reason, a snapshot of the full memory, as used by CoRe, takes 136 MiB and 1.4 ms at any step.

在一台RTX PRO 6000上,GlanceNav每步需要103.9 ms和8.68 GiB,大约是StreamVLN的一半时间和内存,还不到StageVLN的一半时间,它重新编码了8帧,骨干大小相同.
由于记忆有恒定的大小,一步时间沿一个插曲保持平稳. 以一个完整的KV缓存代替,同一主干线从每步93.6米减慢到152.8米,超过500步,而一个八步窗口则停留在84米(Tab. 4).
出于同样的原因, CoRe 使用的全记忆的快照在任何步骤上需要136 MiB和1.4 ms.

blocks.en:
Training cost. Table 3 compares episode-level training with the step-wise training used by most MLLM navigators, on the same backbone and data.
The step-wise model encodes, for every decision, the current frame and up to eight sampled history frames, 27.0M frames per epoch. The episode-level model encodes each of the 3.13M frames once, 8.6 × 8.6\times fewer, and supervises about 100 decisions per forward pass, so one epoch takes 13.5 h instead of 42.6 h.
It also reaches a higher SR (52.4 vs . 46.5), although the step-wise model comes from a separate code base, so this compares two systems and does not isolate the training scheme.

blocks.en:
Agreement of training and inference. We replay real episodes of 64 and 128 steps with the same actions through the training pass and through the streaming path of the Stage-1 model.
The two paths agree on the most likely response token in 99.5 to 100% of the cases and on 99.4 to 99.7% of the bank rows, and their logits differ by a root mean square of 0.03.
The remaining differences are consistent with the different numerical kernels that the two paths use for the GDN recurrence.
blocks.zh:
同意培训和推断。 我们通过训练通过和通过阶段一模式的流路,以同样的动作重播64和128步的真实剧集.
两种途径在99.5至100%的个案和99.4%至99.7%的银行行中商定最可能的反应信号,其记录以0.03的根平均方形不同。
剩余的差异与两条路径用于GDN重现的不同数值内核一致.

Streaming memory. Table 5 trains a Stage-1 model for each memory.
Adding a bank of four keyframes to the four-step window raises SR from 48.7 to 52.4.
The gain depends on what the bank holds. Averaging the token scores of a frame gives 49.3, close to the window alone, and under an earlier training schedule, a bank of randomly chosen tokens did not help at all, whereas a scored bank of the same size raised SR from 46.3 to 49.3 ( Tab. 7 ).
Among the better scores, the differences are small. Keeping tokens by their committed write, as in HOLA [ 6 ] , or by a learned ranker gives 51.7, and our frame-level score is not significantly better ( p = 0.59 p{=}0.59 , exact McNemar test).
We use δ s \delta_{s} because it keeps whole frames, has no parameters, and has the clear reading of Eq. 4 .

收益取决于银行持有什么. 仅凭一个帧的符号分数就给出49.3分,而根据较早的培训时间表,一个随机选择的符号银行根本无济于事,而一个大小相同的得分银行将SR从46.3分提高到49.3分(Tab.7 )。
在较好的分数中,差别很小. 通过他们承诺的书写来保存符文,如HOLA[6],或者通过一个有学识的排位者给出了51.7,我们的帧级分数并不明显更好(p=0.59 p{=}0.59,准确的麦克尼马尔测试).

Scoring rule. Table 5 compares ten parameter-free scores read from the GDN layer below each attention layer, and two learned rankers trained to predict a token’s future attention mass.
The frame-level state-change score of Eq. 2 gives the highest SR. However, the SR of the ten GDN-derived scores has a standard deviation of only 1.1 points (49.0 to 52.4). Neither learned ranker improves on the parameter-free scores.
Averaging the committed write over a frame is the worst frame-level rule, so the result is not explained by frame granularity alone.

将承诺书写在帧上是最糟糕的帧级规则,所以结果不能仅用帧颗粒性来解释.

Moving budget from the window to the bank helps further, and a ninth recent step, which costs about as much as a one-frame bank, lowers SR.

blocks.en:
DAgger labels and data. We follow the recovery protocol of JanusVLN [ 48 ] : the Stage-1 policy drives greedily on the training instructions, and a shortest-path expert takes over after clear failures and returns control to the policy at the next waypoint.
Because the memory of GlanceNav contains its own responses, a takeover restores the memory snapshot taken after the observation and appends the expert’s response instead of the learner’s. Inputs, recurrent state and bank are therefore those of the executed trajectory.
We keep episodes that end at the goal and contain a detour, which gives 14,195 episodes with 1.61M steps.
In 31% of the collected steps, the executed action is a mistake of the learner made before a takeover, so supervising the executed actions imitates these mistakes.
We therefore keep the input stream bit-exact, so that recurrent state and bank match the rollout, and replace only the targets by the expert’s action at every visited state ( oracle relabeling ).
During collection, the expert also overrides the learner’s STOP proposals until the agent is very close to the goal, so near the goal both labels say “keep moving”. We truncate each episode at the learner’s first STOP proposal near the goal and label that step STOP ( STOP correction ).
We train for one epoch from the Stage-1 weights on the DAgger episodes together with the expert demonstrations of the 16,620 training instructions for which no DAgger episode was kept, so that every instruction appears once (30,815 episodes in total).
blocks.zh:
标记和数据。 我们遵循JanusVLN[48]的复苏协议:第一阶段政策贪婪地驱使着训练指示,一位最短路的专家在明显失败后接手,并在下一个方向返回对政策的控制。
GlanceNav的记忆包含自己的反应, 因此,投入、经常状态和银行是执行轨迹中的投入。
我们把结束的剧集保留在球场上,并包含一个绕道,它给出了14,195集,有1.61M步.
在所收集的31%的步骤中,被执行的行动是学习者在收购前所犯的错误,因此监督被执行的行动模仿了这些错误.
因此,我们保持输入流的比特精确性,让反复出现的状态和银行与推出的匹配,并用专家在每个访问的状态(甲骨文重贴标签)的行动来取代目标。
在收集过程中,专家还推翻了学习者的停止建议,直到代理商非常接近目标,因此在目标附近,两个标签都说 " 继续前进 " 。 校对:Soup
我们从阶段一开始为Dagger的剧集训练一个时代,同时进行专家演示16,620个训练指令,没有Dagger的剧集,因此每个指令都出现一次(总共30,815集)。

blocks.en:
Table 8 shows that both the labels and the demonstrations matter. Supervising executed actions does not improve SR, although the agent reaches the goal area far more often (OS 58.0 → \to 70.3), because it also learns the learner’s mistakes and the expert’s refusals to stop. Oracle relabeling adds 6.8 points with the same inputs.
DAgger episodes alone lead to long paths (15.1 m). Adding demonstrations restores path efficiency and gives the best model.

仅Dagger事件就会导致长路径(15.1米). 添加演示可以恢复路径效率,给出最佳模式.

blocks.en:
CoRe vs . GRPO. From the same instructions, CoRe gains more than GRPO in both settings that we ran: 71.9 against 66.8 SR with the mixed instructions ( Tab. 9 ), and 68.7 against 64.3 with R2R-CE instructions only ( Tab. 10 ).
On the full RxR-CE val-unseen split, GRPO and CoRe reach 72.4 and 73.6 SR, 59.6 and 59.6 SPL, and 70.3 and 70.7 nDTW. Both improve the Stage-2 model (67.2 SR, 54.8 SPL, 65.7 nDTW) by more than five points of SR, and CoRe is 1.2 points ahead of GRPO. This margin is smaller than on R2R-CE. A likely reason is that the trigger of CoRe measures the distance to the goal and its expert follows the shortest path, whereas RxR-CE routes are not shortest paths: a branch can start on a correct detour and teach a shortcut.

在完全RxR-CE val-unseen分裂时,GRPO和CoRe达到72.4和73.6 SR,59.6和59.6 SPL,70.3和70.7 nDTW. 两者都将Stage-2型号(67.2 SR,54.8 SPL,65.7 nDTW)改进了超过5分的SR,CoRe比GRPO领先1.2分. 这一比值比R2R-CE小. 一个可能的原因是CoRe的触发器测量距离目标,其专家遵循最短的路径,而RxR-CE路径并不是最短的路径:一个分支可以在正确的绕道上开始,并教授一条捷径.

blocks.en:
Why CoRe learns more from the same instructions. GRPO learns from the contrast between the rollouts of an instruction, and as the policy improves, fewer groups contain both a success and a failure: 64% in the first quarter of training, 36% in the last ( Tab. 9 a). All-fail groups carry no signal. In all-success groups, half of all groups, returns differ only through a stop distance that varies by 0.23 m, yet group normalization gives them half of the total advantage.
A branch contrasts two outcomes from the same state. CoRe keeps about 60% of the groups informative, 75% of its branches succeed, and they rescue 53% of the failed main rollouts.
blocks.zh:
为什么CoRe从同样的指令中学到更多. GPRO从一门教学的推出与政策改进之间的对比中吸取教训,成功和失败的群体较少:培训第一季度为64%,最后季度为36%(表9a)。 所有失败的团体都没有信号 在全部成功组中,所有组中的一半,只通过0.23米的停机距离而不同,然而组的正常化却给予他们总优势的一半.
一个分支对比了来自同一状态的两个结果. CoRe保持了大约60%的团体信息,75%的分支成功,他们挽救了53%失败的主推出.

blocks.en: Where the gain comes from. In Tab. 9 b, the Stage-2 model stops without ever coming within 3 m of the goal in 27.0% of the episodes. CoRe lowers this share to 17.5% and GRPO to 20.3%, while 6 to 8% of the episodes still reach the goal area and leave it. CoRe thus mainly helps the agent reach the goal area, and does not change how reliably it stops.
blocks.zh: 所得之处. 在Tab. 9b中,Stage-2模式在27.0%的剧集中停拍,但从未在进球3米以内出现. CoRe将这一份额降至17.5%,GRPO降至20.3%,而6至8%的剧集仍然到达目标区并离开. CoRe因此主要帮助代理商到达目标区域,不会改变其停止的可靠性.

blocks.en:
Design study. Table 10 a counts the instruction groups that carry a training signal in the runs of Tab. 10 .
As GRPO improves, more groups become all-success or all-failure: over the whole run, about half of its groups have no outcome contrast.
In the first 30 updates of CoRe, 30% of the main rollouts trigger a branch and 72.8% of the branches succeed, rescuing 170 of 338 failed rollouts.
Self-rewind keeps almost as many groups informative as CoRe, but its branches succeed less often (44.5%) and rescue 101 of 343 failed rollouts: the expert adds successful corrections, not more contrast.
In Tab. 10 b, the share of episodes that reached the goal area and then left stays at 7–8% for all models, so CoRe does not change how reliably the agent stops once it is near the goal.

blocks.en:
Where to branch. Imitating expert turn-arounds can make the policy spin in place.
When a branch starts at the trigger t † t^{\dagger} , 80% of the expert’s actions are turns. Rewinding to k ⋆ k^{\star} lowers this share to 57% (62% with the mixed instructions).
In a probe on 16 failed rollouts of the Stage-1 model, branching at k ⋆ k^{\star} with the expert rescued 12 of them, and branching at t † t^{\dagger} only 6 ( p = 0.07 p{=}0.07 ).
With the mixed instructions and the same seed, rewinding to the farthest progress along the reference path, as in BudVLN [ 12 ] , gives 69.7 SR, against 71.9 for the closest approach to the goal.

blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented GlanceNav, a VLN agent that encodes each frame once and keeps a constant-size streaming memory: the recurrent state of a hybrid MLLM, a short window of recent observations, and a bank of keyframes that changed the state the most.
Because the memory is causal and bounded, GlanceNav is trained on whole episodes with its deployment memory, runs at a constant cost per step, and can copy its full memory in 𝒪 ⁡ ( 1 ) \mathcal{O}(1) .
Counterfactual Rewind uses these copies to correct drifting rollouts at their closest approach to the goal and to give counterfactual credit to corrections and continuations.
Using only the R2R-CE and RxR-CE training splits and 1,000 RL instructions, a 4B GlanceNav reaches 71.9 SR on R2R-CE val-unseen and 73.6 on RxR-CE at 104 ms per step.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了GlanceNav,一个VLN代理,它将每个帧编码一次,并保持一个恒定大小的流体内存:一个混合MLLM的反复状态,一个最近观察的短窗口,以及一个键框库,它最能改变状态.
由于内存是因果的且有界限,因此GlanceNav用它的部署内存对全集进行训练,每步运行一次,可以在O QQ (1)\mathcal{O}(1)中复制其全部内存.
反事实 倒带使用这些拷贝在最接近目标时纠正漂移的摇摆,并对校正和继续给予反事实的贷记。
仅使用R2R-CE和RxR-CE的训练拆分和1000 RL指令,4B GlanceNav在R2R-CE val-unseen上达到71.9 SR,在RxR-CE上达到73.6,每步104 ms.
